capabilities: search scholarly databases and look up papers by DOI
insert formatted citations and in-text citations in 60 styles
build and maintain an alphabetical References section with duplicate detection
check a note's references against scholarly databases and mark each found, to review, or not found
create citation notes with paper metadata as properties
extras: Freemium: searches use a shared anonymous budget of 500 per 24 hours per network; without an account, reference checks cover up to 10 references and 5 checks per month per network. A free CiteMe account allows 50 references and 3 checks a month; longer lists need a paid Pro subscription or one-time Thesis Pass. The README warns that the CiteMe token is stored in the plugin's data.json, so it should be kept out of shared or published vaults. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search academic papers, generate formatted citations, or verify that references in a note are real.
summary: Citation tool that searches scholarly databases, inserts formatted citations in 60 styles, and checks whether a note's references exist.
